items.title: Jordyn Tyson: Could debut in Week 9
items.text:
Tyson (hamstring) could be reinstated from injured reserve and make his season debut as soon as next Sunday versus the Browns, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Chris Godwin: Set for No. 1 duties again Week 8
items.text:
Godwin is in line to operate as the Buccaneers de facto No. 1 receiver again in Sunday's Week 8 matchup against the Falcons, as Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) is inactive for the contest per Scott Smith of the team's official site.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
